follow-up time: Median of 76 months for cases and 71 months for controls
outcome: Future pregnancy rates beyond gestational week 24
Modes of delivery in subsequent pregnancies
Rate of uterine ruptures in subsequent pregnancies
cohort: Two groups of women: 26 women who underwent cornual resection for interstitial pregnancy (cases) and 52 women who underwent salpingectomy for tubal ectopic pregnancy (controls)
finding: The study found that cornual resection for interstitial pregnancies did not have a detrimental effect on subsequent pregnancy rates compared to salpingectomy for tubal ectopic pregnancies, but it was associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery in subsequent pregnancies was more common among women having undergone cornual resections (60% vs 18%, p = .006).
